title: Sponza with add-ons (curtains, ivy, trees)
description: Intel's New Sponza (2022, textures reduced to 1k) with three of Intel's add-ons in their shared frame: the curtains, ivy on the walls and cypress trees in the courtyard, for alpha-cutout foliage and heavy-scene tests (about 12.8 M triangles, so only loaded when named). The 10,000-candles add-on is left out until Dennis decides where it goes (proposal: its own scene, sponza-candles, for M2).
